owner: W1-10. The pose grammar every weapon clip is synthesised from (game/src/combat/swing.js). RI-WPN03's Animation Reuse Index is a count of distinct clip ids, and RI-WPN03 M2 only lets an id count if it plays a genuinely different animation — so a clip id in this build resolves to a POSE FAMILY here plus a per-weapon perturbation, and both halves are inspectable.

grounding.source: corpus/70-visual/refs/souls-behaviour/anim/ — 208 animation sequences, frame counts verified in corpus/70-visual/refs/_computed.json.
grounding.measured: 207 named attack/boss move sequences across 27 characters = mean 7.7 distinct authored moves per character (Guardian 15, Gargoyle 13, S-Ornstein 13, Manus 11, Sif 10, Kalameet 10, Artorias 9). Frame counts min 21 / p25 62 / median 90 / p75 127 / max 280 f.
grounding.what_that_licenses: A Souls combatant carries roughly 8-15 authored move clips, not 1 and not 40. That is the reason this library has 34 families rather than 4 (which would be 'three animations') or 500 (which would be per-weapon full authoring nobody can afford). Per-weapon identity is then carried by perturbation of a family, which is exactly RI-WPN03 §B's two-layer inheritance model.
grounding.what_it_does_not_license: The GIFs are 210x118 and dark. Per-frame POSE extraction from them is not credible at that resolution and is not claimed. Frame COUNTS are what is verified and what is cited; the joint angles below are constructed.

profile_fields.shape: the moveset.schema.json `shape` enum value this family produces
profile_fields.arc_scale: fraction of the class's arc_sweep_deg this family sweeps
profile_fields.center_frac: where forward sits inside the arc. 0.5 = centred; 0.0 = the arc starts at forward and travels away
profile_fields.dir: +1 = the blade travels to the character's right, -1 = to the left. Alternating dir down a chain is what makes r1.1/r1.2 read as a combo rather than a repeat
profile_fields.plane_deg: swing plane tilt. 0 horizontal, 90 straight down, negative = a rising cut
profile_fields.cock_frac: anticipation depth as a fraction of arc (RI-WPN05 §E)
profile_fields.follow_frac: follow-through overshoot as a fraction of arc
profile_fields.extend: arm extension at contact, 0 tucked .. 1 locked
profile_fields.twist_deg: blade roll about its own axis at contact
profile_fields.offhand: 0..1 how far the left arm joins the grip. 1.0 = a two-handed grip
profile_fields.root_scale: multiplier on the slot's declared root_dz_m

cut_horizontal.note: The reference cut. Blade drops behind the right hip, rises to a cock with the torso turned away, then a level pass through the centreline led by the hips.

cut_horizontal_rev.note: The backhand return. Shorter cock because the blade is already out to the left; this is what makes r1.2 a continuation rather than a repeat of r1.1.

cut_diagonal.note: Shoulder to opposite hip. The plane tilt is what separates this from cut_horizontal at identical arc.

cut_diagonal_rise.note: A rising cut from low right. Catches a rolling enemy that a horizontal pass goes over — the concrete within-class difference RI-WPN03 §E names for the Kothringi bronze sword.

cut_vertical.note: Overhead split. Narrow in yaw, enormous in pitch.

thrust_straight.note: The point goes where the hips go. cock_frac exceeds 1 because a thrust's whole windup is a retraction — the arc is tiny so the anticipation has to be measured against it.

thrust_low.note: A dropped-shoulder stab under a raised guard. The thrust_through guardbreak family.

thrust_high.note: Shoulder-level stab thrown from behind a raised shield. RI-WPN03's stated example of a within-class heavy that changes what the weapon is for.

sweep_low.note: A shin-height lane sweep. The halberd's reason to exist.

sweep_wide.note: Waist-height, arms long, the pole held at the butt.

spin_full.note: A full body rotation; the hitbox passes behind the player. Grounded in the 46 f Artorias_-_Heavy_Spin.gif and the 32 f Artorias_-_Spin_Attack.gif — the same character carrying two different spins at two different lengths.

spin_double.note: The second revolution: flatter, wider, travelling.

smash_over.note: Straight down through the crown. Almost no yaw; the whole move is pitch and mass. Grounded in Smough-Smash.gif (98 f) and Firesage-Hammer-Smash.gif.

smash_side.note: A round-arm blow that arrives from the side. Smough-Swing.gif (108 f).

smash_pile.note: The Xanmeer pile-driver: both hands overhead, knees driving, no yaw at all. The most committed animation in the roster.

punch_alternate.note: A straight lead. FST alternates hands down the chain; the `offhand` value is what alternates.

punch_hook.note: A hook off the back hand. Wider than the lead and it turns the body over.

lash_circle.note: The lash travels a full circle around the wielder before it lands; the long cock is the coil and the long follow is the recoil. Wraps around a shield's guard angle by construction.

lash_snap.note: An overhead crack straight down the line. Narrower, faster, and it does not wrap.

shoot_level.note: Draw to the cheek and release. No arc: the projectile carries the geometry, and RI-WPN02's hard-fail on a zero arc explicitly exempts `shoot`.

shoot_hip.note: Fired from the hip without a full draw. bow.quick.

roll_rise.note: Out of the roll and up. The character is still on one knee when the hitbox opens: crouch -0.30 m is the lowest pelvis in the roster, and the rising plane is what turns a dodge into a punish on an enemy that is bent over its own recovery.

roll_sweep.note: The rolling heavy: a low spinning cut from the crouch. Only legal for classes with arc >= 120 (RI-WPN01 §A slot 11).

backstep_step.note: The step back is already spent; this is the step FORWARD onto the front foot, thrown square to the target so the facing never breaks. The whole point of the slot is that it recovers ground rather than giving it up.

backstep_cut.note: The wide-arc classes' backstep answer: a stepping diagonal instead of a stepping point.

run_pass.note: Carried through the target at running speed. The short cock is the tell: there is no time to wind up, the momentum IS the windup. root_scale 1.00: the x2.00 running root displacement is RI-WPN04 §A's multiplier, not this family's.

run_lunge.note: A running heavy that arrives point-first with the body behind it. The gap-closer that answers A5 RANGED and A8 CASTER.

run_barge.note: Heavy classes run THROUGH the swing rather than into it: hyperarmour carried on the approach.

jump_fall.note: Airborne: the pelvis is ABOVE its grounded rest (crouch +0.26), knees tucked, the weapon carried overhead and driven down by the fall. Nothing else in the library has a positive crouch.

jump_stomp.note: The jumping heavy on a blunt class: both hands, no yaw, all mass.

plunge_dive.note: Point-down from height, both hands on the grip, legs trailing. plane 96 means the blade is past vertical — it is falling with the player.

guard_counter_shove.note: The shield hand shoves the blocked weapon aside (offhand is NEGATIVE — the left arm drives away from the grip, the only family where it does) and the main hand comes through the gap it made. cock 0.14 because the block already loaded it.

guardbreak_kick.note: The Souls kick. The weapon barely moves; the leg does everything, the torso leans BACK for the counterweight (negative lean, unique in the library).

guardbreak_shoulder.note: A barge with the weapon shoulder. Heavy classes cannot kick with a great hammer in their hands.

guardbreak_bash.note: shield.bash — the offhand leads and the main hand is parked. offhand -0.9 is the strongest left-arm drive in the library.

shield_charge.note: Both hands on the greatshield, shoulder behind it, 2.6 m of travel.

art_lunge.note: The committed weapon-art lunge: a deep crouch, a long hold, and the longest travel of any melee slot.

art_whirl.note: A travelling whirl. Answers A7 SWARM and A10 GANK_DUO by controlling angle rather than distance.

art_stomp.note: The ground-breaker art. Grounded in Golem-Ground-Pound.gif (108 f) and Stray-Smash.gif.

art_guard.note: A stance art: the weapon is held low and thrown from the guard rather than wound up.

charge_hold.note: The charged heavy. The very deep cock IS the hold phase — the player is a statue at the top of the windup with the weapon fully loaded.

charge_hold_thrust.note: The charged heavy for thrust classes: the point is drawn back past the hip and held there.

run_leap.note: The running heavy that leaves the ground: a short hop at the end of the approach so the whole body mass arrives with the weapon. Positive crouch (airborne) and the second-largest root scale in the library. Grounded in Ornstein-Jump.gif (91 f) and Stray-Leap.gif (145 f).

two_hand_transform.note: Applied to a family to produce its two-handed counterpart. RI-WPN06 §B requires that a two-handed slot be a genuinely different clip, not the same clip with multipliers; this transform is what makes it one. Every field below is a delta or a multiplier on the one-handed profile, and all six of them change the tip's path through space.
